theorem local_actual_saddle_branch (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (z v : ℂ)

        ∃ B : ℂ → ℂ, (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ < 1 → AnalyticAt ℂ B z) ∧
        ∀ z : ℂ, ‖z-(x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 →
          B z ∈ closedBall w (1/x) ∧ complexSlope 3 t (B z) = -(Complex.I*z) ∧
          |(B z).im| < Real.pi/8 ∧ modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z) ≠ 0 ∧
          modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z)) ≠ 0 ∧

                weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I)))/2 ∧
          ‖(∫ y : ℝ in (B (conj z)).im..(B z).im, weight 3 t z ((y : ℂ)*Complex.I))/

          ‖RiemannEvenFlow.flow 3 t z-
            (modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)+conj (modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z))))/2‖ ≤
            η*(‖modelGaussianAmplitude t z (B z)‖+‖modelGaussianAmplitude t (conj z) (B (conj z))‖)

theorem exponential_tail_absorption (c Q Δ t u : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (ht : 1 ≤ t) (hlo : c*Real.exp (3*u) ≤ t)
    (hhi : t ≤ Q*Real.exp (4*u)) (hΔ : Real.exp (-u) ≤ Δ)
    (hdom : u^2+12*u ≤ (c/2)*Real.exp (2*u)) :
    u*Real.exp (u^2)*(t*Real.exp (-t*Δ)+t^2*Real.exp (-t*Real.exp (-u))) ≤
      (Q+Q^2)*u*Real.exp (-4*u) ∧
    Real.exp (u^2/(2*t)-(t/2)*Real.exp (-u)) ≤ Real.exp (-4*u)

    (hf : ∀ w ∈ closedBall (a : ℂ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℂ f w)

theorem real_simple_zero (f : ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ w ∈ closedBall (a : ℂ) 1, DifferentiableAt ℂ f w)
    (hconj : ∀ w, f (conj w)=conj (f w))
